title: Surrender Processing Fee Schedule for Universal Life Insurance
content:
A surrender processing fee is taken off the cash surrender value on the full surrender of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy. The fee follows the policy year of the surrender, counted from the issue date to the surrender's effective date.

## Fee schedule

| Policy year of the surrender | Surrender processing fee |
|---|---|
| Up to policy year **5** (the early fee year) | Early fee, **$75** |
| After policy year 5 and within the tier's surrender charge years | Late fee, **$50** |
| After the tier's surrender charge years | No fee |

The tier's surrender charge years are **15** on the Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL and **10** on the Ashgrove Protection UL, Ashgrove Accumulation UL, Ashgrove Indexed UL Protect, Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth and Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier.

## By tier

| Policy year | Lifetime Guarantee UL | Every other tier |
|---|---|---|
| 1 to 5 | $75 | $75 |
| 6 to 10 | $50 | $50 |
| 11 to 15 | $50 | none |
| 16 and later | none | none |

## Hypothetical readings

An Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth policy surrendered in policy year 5 pays $75; in policy year 10, $50; in policy year 11, nothing. An Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL surrendered in policy year 13 pays $50.
